invariants.must_contain: camera moves in the view plane
invariants.why: pan is defined by the camera matrix columns; moving in the ground plane instead is the classic OrbitControls mistake

invariants.must_contain: meshes do NOT rotate with the camera
invariants.why: only the camera orbits; rotating the meshes would put the pinned textures on the wrong faces
the true-isometric angle vs the 2:1 dimetric 30 degrees is the number that keeps the look consistent with the 2D editor
